page.description: A page id from the map (design, spec, architecture/media), a decision (D29) or a skill (skills/<name>, skills/<name>/<reference>).

section.description: One section of the page: its heading's words (Steps) or its anchor (#steps).

full.description: The whole page even when it is long.

file.description: The source: its name under sources/ (brief.docx), sources/brief.docx or its path.

offset.description: Where to start in the text (characters), for a text longer than 60000 characters.

images.description: Send the pictures the readable version names (8 at most) with the text.

refresh.description: false: read what is there without writing it again.

profiles.description: LMS profile ids (elabora_list_profiles). Default: course.json delivery.lms, else ["unknown"]: no LMS chosen, the strictest values, and package limits only warn.

release.description: Client delivery: the plan needs a validated version.

language.description: Check this translation, regenerated from the source; omit for the source language.

allowMissing.description: With language: check a draft with missing/stale texts kept in the source language and unplaced anchors at line starts.

screen.description: Default: the screen of the last look, else the first screen.

step.description: Reveal the steps of the screen up to this one (default: all).

layer.description: Open this layer of the screen (the window is captured).

at.description: A timed screen at a moment (the window is captured, with the bar): "l2" (a line starts, its caption shown), "l2:end", "l2:imprimante" (a word of it), "l2:imprimante+0.3s", "1.5s@2" (seconds into step 2, screens without narration), "step2:end", or "12.5" (seconds on the timeline).

sheet.description: A contact sheet of a timed screen: one capture per mark of its timeline (its start, each block that comes or goes, each cue, each step's end), captioned with the anchor and what happens: review a narrated slide as a storyboard.

language.description: A translation of the course (default: its language).

viewport.description: Only the window (default: the whole page).

motion.description: Animations on (default: reduced motion, transitions settled).

scroll.description: The window scrolled to a position, animations on: px ("1800"), a percentage of the page ("100%"), or a block's id (the block in view). Several positions (or sheet on a screen without a timeline, default 0/25/50/75/100%): a contact sheet down the page, to see scroll-driven animations build up.

block.description: A close-up of this block (cropped to its box with a small margin; PNG by default up to 2 megapixels, else JPEG), scrolled into view unless scroll says where. With scroll, block or motion the note says what moves: visible/clipped/outside, the animations and transitions of each block in the window (or of this block), their timeline (time, scroll, view) and progress, and the scroll-driven ones that CANNOT FINISH because the page ends before their range.

scale.description: The close-up drawn at twice its size (2) to read fine detail.

act.description: Drive the free object of block from inside its frame, in order, before the capture: "click:<text>" (a button, link, text or label named so), "click:role=<role>[name=<name>]", "key:<key>" (Enter, ArrowRight, a), "drag:x,y->x,y" (0 to 1 across the object). The note gives the object's state and the events it emitted; a missing target names what the frame offers. Explore with it; keep an interaction worth keeping in object.tests.json (elabora_test_object).

type.description: Image format (default: JPEG; PNG for a close-up up to 2 megapixels).

fresh.description: Measure again the screens unchanged since their last measure.

language.description: A BCP 47 tag: en, de, pt-BR.

allowMissing.description: With language: check the draft, leaving missing/stale texts in the source language.

force.description: Time lines already timed by the same aligner again.

in.description: A moment and its effect: { "at": <anchor>, "effect": "rise", "duration": 0.5, "direction": "left" }. Anchors: { "line": "l2" } (the line starts), { "line": "l2", "edge": "end" }, { "line": "l2", "word": "imprimante" } (the voice says that word; a few words work too; occurrence: 2 for its second time; offset: 0.3 seconds after, negative before); on a screen without narration { "seconds": 1.5 } from the start of the block's step ({ "seconds": 1.5, "step": 2 }); { "step": 2 } or { "step": 2, "edge": "end" }. Effects: none, fade (default), rise, slide, zoom, wipe, draw, or the theme's (course.json theme.effects). Fields set to null go back to their default; the whole moment null removes it.

out.description: A moment and its effect: { "at": <anchor>, "effect": "rise", "duration": 0.5, "direction": "left" }. Anchors: { "line": "l2" } (the line starts), { "line": "l2", "edge": "end" }, { "line": "l2", "word": "imprimante" } (the voice says that word; a few words work too; occurrence: 2 for its second time; offset: 0.3 seconds after, negative before); on a screen without narration { "seconds": 1.5 } from the start of the block's step ({ "seconds": 1.5, "step": 2 }); { "step": 2 } or { "step": 2, "edge": "end" }. Effects: none, fade (default), rise, slide, zoom, wipe, draw, or the theme's (course.json theme.effects). Fields set to null go back to their default; the whole moment null removes it.

profiles.description: LMS profile ids (elabora_list_profiles). Default: course.json delivery.lms, else ["unknown"]: no LMS chosen, the strictest values, and package limits only warn.

target.description: scorm12 (default): a package for LMSs. web: a module for a plain web server.

web.description: Settings of the web target (target "web" only). A publication: the defaults. A showcase: { progress: "none", navigation: "free" }. A review link: { review: { origins: ["https://revue.elabora.studio"] } }.

progress.description: local (default): kept in the browser, the learner resumes at the next visit. none: nothing kept, a reload starts again.

navigation.description: authored (default): the course's navigation rules and locks. free: every screen open from the outline and Next, nothing to complete first.

noindex.description: Ask search engines not to index the module (a review, a private link).

url.description: Absolute address where the module's index.html will be served (https://…): canonical link and sharing previews.

image.description: Sharing image shown when the link is shared (PNG, JPEG or WebP, 1200×630 reads well): a path in the course folder (assets/…) or absolute. Needs url for previews.

review.description: A module for the Revue: it carries the review bridge (elabora-review/1, docs/review-bridge.md) and talks only to review pages of these origins, which show it in an iframe. Defaults then: progress none, navigation free, noindex.

origins.description: Origins of the review pages: https://revue.elabora.studio; http://localhost:<port> for development. No path.

languages.description: all: one package of every language (D59): the course's own and each translation that is ready and approved, which learners switch in place (the player's language item). Not with language.

language.description: Build/test this translation from the source course; outputs go into the source course dist/. Omit for the source language.

allowMissing.description: With language: explicitly make a draft; missing/stale texts stay in the source language and unplaced word anchors move to line starts.

profiles.description: LMS profile ids (elabora_list_profiles). Default: course.json delivery.lms, else ["unknown"]: no LMS chosen, the strictest values, and package limits only warn.

path.description: Absolute path of the file (a PDF, a spreadsheet, a document, an image).

addResources.description: Files copied into assets/resources/ and added to the resources, each in its own undoable change (before the other changes): titled by title, else the PDF's own title, else the file's name.

linkTerms.description: Link the glossary's terms to the screens, the first time in each: true for every term, or the ids of some.

family.description: A vetted family ("EB Garamond"), or the family name to declare for from/files (default: the font's own).

weights.description: Static fonts: the weights to take (default: all vetted; 400 and 700 for a Fontsource package). A variable file covers its whole range.

subsets.description: The subsets to embed: latin, latin-ext (vetted fonts), or any of a Fontsource package (cyrillic, greek, vietnamese…). Default: latin, and latin-ext when a language of the course needs it.

for.description: Tokens that get the font's stack: body, heading, mono, display… or ["none"].

from.description: Folder or .tgz of a Fontsource package (npm @fontsource/<id>, @fontsource-variable/<id>): its files of the subsets (with their unicode ranges) and LICENSE.

files.description: Local WOFF2 (or WOFF) files of one family.

license.description: With files: the licence file of the font (OFL.txt, LICENSE…).

from.description: Version the instances are at, when elabora.lock.json does not know it.

props.description: Props to preview instead of the examples.

only.description: Only generators whose file name contains this text.

sheet.description: Return a contact sheet (PNG) of the assets written.

change.description: Id or seq of the change to undo.

batch.description: Id of the batch to undo, or true for the last batch of AI work.
